senses.sense_definition: The act of living together in the same place.

examples.text: The couple decided that <w>cohabitation</w> was the best way to save money on rent.
Many young people now view <w>cohabitation</w> as a normal step before getting married.

senses.sense_definition: An intimate relationship where partners live together without being legally or religiously married.

examples.text: Laws regarding <w>cohabitation</w> vary significantly from one country to another.
They entered into <w>cohabitation</w> after dating for only three months.

senses.sense_definition: A political arrangement where a president and prime minister belong to opposing parties.

examples.text: The French government faced a difficult period of <w>cohabitation</w> between the two leaders.
Political analysts often debate the effectiveness of <w>cohabitation</w> in a divided government.

senses.sense_definition: The state of two different species sharing the same natural environment.

examples.text: The <w>cohabitation</w> of these two bird species is rare in such a small forest.
Scientists studied the <w>cohabitation</w> of predators and prey in the protected reserve.

senses.sense_definition: A shared residence where multiple individuals live together.

examples.text: The old house served as a <w>cohabitation</w> for several struggling artists.
They turned the large apartment into a communal <w>cohabitation</w> for students.
